howto.what: 当您咨询自动化工作流相关问题时，Claude 会依据三份参考文件回答：创建方案时参考 patterns.md，诊断问题时参考 sharp_edges.md，审查输入时参考 validations.md。
howto.when: 当您提到“automation”、“workflow”、“zapier”、“no-code”等关键词，或询问如何集成工具、自动化流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Zapier 连接 Airtable 和 Slack。
say.note: Claude 会根据 patterns.md 给出创建方案。

say.text: 这个自动化工作流哪里容易出错？
检查我的自动化方案是否符合最佳实践。

howto.what_en: When you ask about automation workflows, Claude answers using three reference files: patterns.md for creation, sharp_edges.md for diagnosis, and validations.md for review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "automation", "workflow", "zapier", "no-code", or ask about integrating tools or automating processes.

say_en.text: Help me connect Airtable and Slack using Zapier.
say_en.note: Claude will use patterns.md to give a creation plan.

say_en.text: What could go wrong in this automation workflow?
say_en.note: Claude will reference sharp_edges.md for risk diagnosis.

say_en.text: Check if my automation follows best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will use validations.md for review.
